mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tutoring_need ( student_id, subject, grade, description, location, expected_price, time_requirement, contact_phone, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{subject}, #{grade}, #{description}, #{location}, #{expectedPrice}, #{timeRequirement}, #{contactPhone}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tutoring_need SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tutoring_need WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
